Self-registered point in the 'Unidades productivas / Quintas /Huertas con venta directa' layer of the Rutas Sanas del Alimento map, kept by the Red Interregional de Nodos Agroecologicos. It publishes the unit's coordinates, its declared production and the contact route the producer entered; entries carry no date and no review. Locates the holding at parcel A149 of camino 16 in the IDEVI and declares grass-fed steer rearing with beef sale and a family garden, with a mobile and an email.

notes: The map files the point under the Adolfo Alsina departamento, whose name is shared with a Buenos Aires partido; the row names Viedma, the departmental seat that the IDEVI belongs to.
